toleranceRationale: The memory engine matches by whole-query substring and every golden item's memoryQuery was authored until its expected docs retrieve at rank 1, so retrieval is deterministic and perfect by construction: bars sit at exactly 1.0 with zero headroom. Any dip means the fixture corpus, the golden set, and the memoryQuery values drifted apart (a doc id renamed, a phrase edited out) — a mechanical breakage this gate exists to catch, not retrieval-quality noise. No judge.* bars: the memory leg never runs the model-costed judge (per-PR carve-out in docs/eval/KNOWLEDGE.md). Raising or lowering any bar requires a PR editing this file with a one-line justification.
